name: Paediatrics (0-2 years)
summary: Ward-based learning with babies and infants. Focus on age-specific presentations, developmental context and family communication.
placementFocus: Systematic approach to the unwell infant
recommendations: Use a fixed framework (cause by system or by pathway) for every presentation and write it down after the ward.
Practise infant observation: colour, tone, breathing effort, hydration, interaction.
Learn normal ranges for heart rate, respiratory rate and weight by age before learning abnormal.
Ask to observe a newborn check and a parent counselling conversation.
